items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact image
items.tradition: Chinese small seal script, as labeled by the record
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of the Shuowen seal-style form of 刀, the phonetic element named in the usual analysis of 到.
items.alt: A modern vector redraw of the seal-style character 刀.
items.selection_reason: Shows the independently identified seal-style form of the phonetic component. It is not evidence for an ancient sound change or for the shape of 到 itself.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states CC0 1.0 for the file; its provenance notes a Xiaoxuetang source image and also includes Richard Sears permission wording. The selected component form is independently present in Xiaoxuetang query record 27.5200, whose official notice releases queried glyph images and attributes under CC0.

limitations.text: The character-specific 到 seal image could not be verified, so this component illustration must not be captioned as a historical form of the whole character 到.
